        About this item

        • TRACK HEALTH PATTERNS¹ IN YOUR SLEEP WITH VITALS²: Stay aware of the subtle changes in your body with Vitals¹–it tracks health metrics while you sleep, catches shifts from your usual patterns, and provides tailored guidance based on the insights.²
        • A PERSONALIZED COACH FOR YOUR FITNESS GOALS: Whether you're building endurance for a long trek or training to build muscle, Fitness Index³ delivers tailored guidance based on your fitness level goals. Finally, train smarter with your fitness watch.
        • EVERYDAY AI ASSISTANCE, SIMPLIFIED: With the Galaxy Watch9, you can just raise your wrist, start talking naturally and get instant AI assistance⁴—no wake phrase needed. This smart watch won’t slow you down.
        • ONE PERSONALIZED SCORE TO KNOW YOUR HEART BETTER: Instead of checking multiple metrics separately, track the single Heart Health Score⁵ based on sleep time, BMI, activity and vascular load to stay aware of your wellness.
        • TRACK YOUR NIGHTS. OWN YOUR DAYS: Galaxy Watch9 gives you personalized recommendations and habit-building guidance with Advanced Sleep Coaching.⁶ Plus, Bedtime Guidance⁷ helps you find your optimal bedtime so you can wake up feeling refreshed.
        • CHECK YOUR BLOOD PRESSURE EASILY: Stay aware of your blood pressure conveniently with your smart watch. Simply calibrate your Galaxy Watch9 using a blood pressure cuff (sold separately) to measure your systolic and diastolic pressure.⁸
        • COMFORTABLE WEAR. FORGET IT’S THERE: A watch meant for daily health tracking should be comfortable enough for daily wear. The unbelievably soft sports band with a breathable air pocket design never gets in the way of your goals.
        • NEED TO PAY? YOUR WRIST WORKS: From post-run coffee stops to everyday errands, use Tap to Pay⁹ on your Galaxy Watch9 and keep your essentials right where you need them — on your wrist.
        • WATCH PAIRS WITH YOUR ANDROID SMARTPHONE: Galaxy Watch works seamlessly with Samsung phones and also works with other Android phones.¹⁰ Download the Galaxy Wearable and Samsung Health apps to get started using Galaxy Watch with your device.

        • What colors do Galaxy Watch9 come in?

          Galaxy Watch9 is available in different colors based on the size option. 40mm model: Available in Cream and Graphite. 44mm model: Available in Silver and Graphite

        • How much larger is the Galaxy Watch9 battery compared to Galaxy Watch8?

          The 40mm model has a 390 mAh battery, and the 44mm model has a 445 mAh battery. The higher capacity allows Galaxy Watch9 to require less frequent charging. This means you can keep the Watch powered throughout the day with minimal downtime.

        • What kind of processor does Galaxy Watch9 use?

          Galaxy Watch9 uses the Snapdragon Wear Elite Platform. This advanced processor delivers smooth, seamless performance with less lag or load. Also, it supports quick app launches and fluid, responsive interactions.

        • Does Galaxy Watch9 have a clear display?

          Galaxy Watch9 features a sapphire crystal display that delivers a brightness level of up to 3,000 nits, ensuring clear visibility even in bright sunlight. The high-resolution screen provides crisp visuals for notifications, apps and health data.

        • My Galaxy Watch9 is charging slowly, do I have to use the charger that comes with it?

          The Galaxy Watch9 comes with a charger that is specific to its model, and it charges best using only that charger. To get the best charging performance, use provided wireless charger that comes in the box.

        Product Description

        From your first morning stretch to “goodnight,” Galaxy Watch9 makes staying on top of your everyday health easy, especially with its comfortable design that’s perfect for daily wear.

        Stay aware of the subtle changes¹ in your body with Vitals,² improve your sleep schedule with Sleep Coaching³ and keep close tabs on your heart every day with the Heart Health Score⁵ that also comes with personalized guidance.⁶ Got a fitness goal for yourself? Fitness Index can be your personal coach by recommending programs³ tailored to you. And during your daily chores when you need quick AI assistance,⁹ you can just raise your wrist and talk naturally —no wake phrase needed.

        Prioritizing your health gets easier when managing daily tasks is easy. With Watch9 you can easily access your wallet to use Tap to Pay,¹³ control your camera and more.

        Watch9 helps you stay connected, stay motivated and get closer to your health and fitness goals.

        5 out of 5 stars
        Great smartwatch!
        This is my very first smartwatch, and I bought it mainly for step tracking. But I quickly realized how convenient it is to be able to read messages and answer phone calls right from my watch, especially when I have no idea where I left my phone. :-) I was a little worried that I would have to charge it every single day because I had read reviews about some of the older models. But surprisingly, I only need to charge my watch about once every three days. Even more impressive, it takes only about 1–1.5 hours to fully charge. The watch band is on the smaller side, which was the first thing I noticed when I received it. My wrist is pretty skinny, though, so it fits me perfectly — almost like it was made for me! :-) And even if you have a wider wrist, there are plenty of compatible bands available on Amazon in different colors and sizes. I pre-ordered my watch before the release date, so I also received a $50 gift card, which was a really nice bonus. Overall, this was a great purchase, and I’m really happy I got it!

          Great Upgrade from Galaxy Watch 5
          Reviewed in the United States on August 21, 2026
          Color: CreamSize: 40mmStyle: BluetoothPattern Name: Watch9 Only
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
          Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

          As someone who loved her Galaxy Watch 5, I was very excited to finally upgrade to the Watch 9. My old watch finally died this week, which seemed like perfect timing with the new coming out (though I wish I could have taken advantage of pre-order deals but alas). Luckily, I was able to get a replacement pretty quickly and in a color I liked as well.

          First, I have to say that while I love my watch, it was a bit of a panic attack at first, as the setup was way different from my first watch. As someone who mostly used her watch for productivity tasks, step tracking, and heart rate monitoring during workouts, I found all the new fitness-tracking features extremely overwhelming. I almost sent it back because I wasn't sure if I wanted all these options. Since I didn't want to put up with the lack of functionality and durability of the Fitbit, I decided to stick it out and just turn off some of the features. It was better to have them in case I wanted them later.

          Once I got my watch working, though, I was very impressed. The fit has been great and it seems more durable than my old watch. The only disappointing thing about it has been that it doesn't work with any of my old Galaxy Watch chargers, which is annoying since I will have to buy new ones. Fairly minor, but still disappointing. I also love that there are so many band options (I personally am not a fan of silicone bands). Overall though, I love the color of my watch and how it feels, and consider it a good value for the money.

          It could have been 5 stars.
          Reviewed in the United States on August 22, 2026
          Color: GraphiteSize: 44mmStyle: BluetoothPattern Name: Watch9 Only
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

          The Samsung Watch 9 is a good-looking watch. I find its thin design is much

          better looking than the new bulky/thick Samsung Ultra2. This watch looks gorgeous,

          feels well made, is easy to read and is bright enough at 3000 nits. The Watch 9

          is also very comfortable to wear. The new silicone strap makes this possible. I

          am excited to see the previous strap is gone. The old strap was uncomfortable

          and always difficult to put on. I was never fond of the previous folding-in

          strap design. I have experienced battery life from 2 to 3 days which I

          find acceptable. The watch is turned off when not in use.

          The biggest problem with the watch is that its charging method is not

          backwards compatible. It will not charge on my existing wireless charger

          or charge from the puck of my previous Samsung watch. So, if you do not have

          a usb-c charger lying around for the included puck, you need to buy that as

          well. The charging puck included with the Watch 9 has a different charging

          configuration than what was used in Samsung's previous generations.

          While on the subject of charging, I noticed that even if the watch is turned

          off prior to charging, the Watch 9 will boot itself up again while charging.

          I find this very irritating. Due to this, I now have to remember to turn the

          watch off AFTER it is fully charged. Maybe it's me, but I do not want the watch

          to be constantly on when not in use.

          Charging time is about 2 hours (from 20% to 100% charge).

          I would have given this watch 5 stars, if it were not for the charging

          issues I have encountered.

          Perfect watch face size for an average womans wrist size, but the band with the 40mm watch is very small, i could only use it with the last hole and it was tight.

          I bought the bluetooth version for the health tracking features which I love so far but am still getting used to them. I noticed once I turned the health tracking features on the battery runs down faster. I probably went from charging every 1.5-2 days to once a day and that is with the AOD off. For example, I had it charged to 100% around 9:00 am, and with normal activity throughout the day it is now at 52% at 6:55 pm.

          Fast response times; great health tracking features with vitals, sleep tracking, automatic workout detection; and it had a bright clear display. I just wish the battery lasted a tad longer.

        About this Item

        • TRACK HEALTH PATTERNS¹ IN YOUR SLEEP WITH VITALS²: Stay aware of the subtle changes in your body with Vitals¹–it tracks health metrics while you sleep, catches shifts from your usual patterns, and provides tailored guidance based on the insights.²
        • A PERSONALIZED COACH FOR YOUR FITNESS GOALS: Whether you're building endurance for a long trek or training to build muscle, Fitness Index³ delivers tailored guidance based on your fitness level goals. Finally, train smarter with your fitness watch.
        • EVERYDAY AI ASSISTANCE, SIMPLIFIED: With the Galaxy Watch9, you can just raise your wrist, start talking naturally and get instant AI assistance⁴—no wake phrase needed. This smart watch won’t slow you down.
        • ONE PERSONALIZED SCORE TO KNOW YOUR HEART BETTER: Instead of checking multiple metrics separately, track the single Heart Health Score⁵ based on sleep time, BMI, activity and vascular load to stay aware of your wellness.
        • TRACK YOUR NIGHTS. OWN YOUR DAYS: Galaxy Watch9 gives you personalized recommendations and habit-building guidance with Advanced Sleep Coaching.⁶ Plus, Bedtime Guidance⁷ helps you find your optimal bedtime so you can wake up feeling refreshed.
        • CHECK YOUR BLOOD PRESSURE EASILY: Stay aware of your blood pressure conveniently with your smart watch. Simply calibrate your Galaxy Watch9 using a blood pressure cuff (sold separately) to measure your systolic and diastolic pressure.⁸
        • COMFORTABLE WEAR. FORGET IT’S THERE: A watch meant for daily health tracking should be comfortable enough for daily wear. The unbelievably soft sports band with a breathable air pocket design never gets in the way of your goals.
        • NEED TO PAY? YOUR WRIST WORKS: From post-run coffee stops to everyday errands, use Tap to Pay⁹ on your Galaxy Watch9 and keep your essentials right where you need them — on your wrist.
        • WATCH PAIRS WITH YOUR ANDROID SMARTPHONE: Galaxy Watch works seamlessly with Samsung phones and also works with other Android phones.¹⁰ Download the Galaxy Wearable and Samsung Health apps to get started using Galaxy Watch with your device.

        Product Description

        From your first morning stretch to “goodnight,” Galaxy Watch9 makes staying on top of your everyday health easy, especially with its comfortable design that’s perfect for daily wear.

        Stay aware of the subtle changes¹ in your body with Vitals,² improve your sleep schedule with Sleep Coaching³ and keep close tabs on your heart every day with the Heart Health Score⁵ that also comes with personalized guidance.⁶ Got a fitness goal for yourself? Fitness Index can be your personal coach by recommending programs³ tailored to you. And during your daily chores when you need quick AI assistance,⁹ you can just raise your wrist and talk naturally —no wake phrase needed.

        Prioritizing your health gets easier when managing daily tasks is easy. With Watch9 you can easily access your wallet to use Tap to Pay,¹³ control your camera and more.

        Watch9 helps you stay connected, stay motivated and get closer to your health and fitness goals.
